development.population: Source-only development descriptor for a shared evidence-constrained generator. This parent descriptor is not a target population and will not be executed. The author declares separate Lifelines and Pani source populations and their age supports. No target individual data or target effects are supplied.

lifelines.population: Lifelines western-European unrelated adults selected for GWAS, oldest family members preferred; n=2921 eligible; excludes self-reported diabetes or FPG>=7.0 mmol/L, significant anemia, and missing HbA1c/erythrocytes/FPG. Table 2 row-specific n unknown; Table 3 complete-case n unresolved.

pani.population: Pani NHANES 2001-2004 n=3270, adults age>=25, no self-reported diabetes, FPG<126 mg/dL, HbA1c available. Complex survey design and weights. FOS context is different and is not pooled. NHANES overlaps Liu1999-2008.

assumptions.description: Common contract domain is nonnegative integer age, binary female, positive BMI/HbA1c and 0<fasting glucose<126 mg/dL. Actual source ages are 18..90 for Lifelines and 25..90 for Pani. Lifelines adult lower bound18 and both upper bounds90 are declared computational assumptions, not recovered source limits. Pani >=70 includes 70..90; no target bounds or quotas apply. No added BMI or HbA1c upper bound is claimed. Development is a nonexecuted descriptor; program rejects that selector.

Lifelines integer ages are rounded Normal(55.5,9.9^2), rejected outside18..90. Published mean/SD do not determine a distribution or support. Truncation/rounding produce approximate rather than forcibly matched moments. Analytic age-feature centering sums exact discrete Gaussian bin masses on this declared support.

Pani eight age-bin probabilities equal published unweighted n/3270; ages are uniform integers within25..39,40..44,45..49,50..54,55..59,60..64,65..69,70..90. This is an unweighted sample-population proxy, not recovered survey weights. Open upper stratum is explicitly capped90 as an unestimated support assumption.

Both contexts use independent Bernoulli female probability0.597, lognormal BMI with mean26.5 SD4.1, and Normal glucose pretruncation mean91.8 SD9 rejected outside(0,126). Lifelines summaries support these locations/spreads but not distributional shapes; Pani corresponding marginals are unreported and are transferred unchanged as an explicit sensitivity assumption. Glucose centering uses its analytic posttruncation expectation, not a fitted context adjustment. Published glucose summary is approximately reproduced after truncation.

Age, sex, BMI, glucose and residual noise are mutually independent in both source populations. Their covariance is not reported and is not identified as zero. This fixed simplification is never optimized, shared across structures, and restricts the analytical uses of the synthetic data. No sex term is included because its conditional coefficient is unidentified; zero is a structural assumption, not a source finding.

Lifelines location5.6 is its whole-source HbA1c mean; center age feature at its analytic whole-source expectation. Pani location5.44 is specifically its55..59 stratum HbA1c mean; center age feature at the average over assumed uniform integer ages55..59. BMI/glucose centers equal their common assumed marginal expectations and independence makes these the stratum expectations too. These fixed published source anchors are not independently fitted offsets. Their contrast can reflect selection, composition, measurement and other unmeasured factors; none is causally attributed. A common fitted correction allows joint approximate source reconciliation. A new target HbA1c location remains unidentified.

Within each source, conditional HbA1c location equals its fixed published reference location plus one shared correction and shared age-feature, BMI and glucose terms. Shared coefficients express an unvalidated transport assumption. Jansen Table2 slopes are separate age/sex-adjusted projections, not automatically joint coefficients; population equality to the conditional BMI/glucose terms follows only from the declared independence. Pani is a survey-adjusted age projection; the unweighted operator approximates that estimand. Nonlinear age coefficient is a feature coefficient, not the reported linear projection.

Individual residual noise is Gaussian with common nonnegative fitted SD, independent of all covariates. Nonpositive HbA1c draws are rejected to satisfy the positive-domain contract; at these source locations this is negligible but changes the exact Gaussian law in the far tail. Source marginal HbA1c SD0.3 is not a residual SD; initialization subtracts variance of the linear independent predictor terms. Pani mean SEs are never converted into individual SDs. Neither residual shape, heteroscedasticity nor cross-source residual transport is identified.

Task units are HbA1c NGSP percent and fasting glucose mg/dL. Jansen immunoassay and Pani HPLC differ; both standardized scales are treated as identical task measurements without an invented assay correction. Frozen conversions are glucose factor18 and NGSP0.09148*IFCC+2.152 for levels, multiplier only for spreads/slopes. Rounded alternate HbA1c unit summaries are duplicate representations, not extra constraints. Jansen printed CI levels remain unknown.

All five fitted scalars are ordinary common source-law parameters. Location correction[-0.10,0.10] is a declared modeling allowance equal to one printed Lifelines mean increment, not a confidence interval. Age-feature coefficient[0,0.020] is a positive-association sensitivity range up to twice reported Pani slope, not a recovered interval. BMI/glucose bounds are the converted printed Jansen projection interval endpoints, with unknown coverage and conditional interpretation contingent on independence. Residual SD[0,0.3] is the independent-additive variance constraint implied by a marginal source SD0.3; allowing0 does not assert determinism. No context, support, distribution or covariance descriptor is fit.

All20 prescribed operators are retained once, each with weight1. The normalized weighted MSE is a pragmatic engineering objective, not a likelihood, calibrated probability or clinical utility. Repeated source diagnostics and overlapping NHANES evidence are not independent confirmations. Fit only seed19101 with<=40trials including baseline; assess baseline/selected at unused19111 and19123. Equality is not improvement. Source agreement does not establish target validity.

Liu's univariate equation is contextual only and is never used as a joint intercept/slope. Jansen Table3 quantities remain quarantined. No FOS coefficient, IPD, target inputs/outcomes, previous candidate outputs, broad retrieval or new sources are used. The exact32-item admitted evidence bytes are retained.

Age feature is age-0.5*max(age-60,0), continuous with half the pre60 rate after60. Pani marginal means show flattening in older strata, motivating a low-complexity sensitivity only. Knot60 and half-rate are fixed authored choices, not estimated biological thresholds; marginal curvature does not identify conditional curvature or distinguish composition effects. Same source populations, covariance, anchors, supports, measurements and parameter budget as the linear structure. Centering changes analytically with feature shape, not by fitting population descriptors.

location_correction.derivation: Common additive correction to fixed published source-specific reference locations; initialized0. Bounds are assumptions, not sampling error.

age_coefficient.derivation: Initial0.010 uses reported linear projection as an initialization. In the alternative the feature coefficient differs from its source-population OLS age projection.

bmi_coefficient.derivation: Initialized from separate age/sex-adjusted projection; equivalence to conditional term requires fixed covariate independence.

glucose_coefficient.derivation: Initialized from separate age/sex-adjusted projection, converted using0.09148/18; equivalence to conditional term requires independence.

residual_sd.derivation: Initial sqrt(0.3^2-(0.010*9.9)^2-(0.0118924*4.1)^2-(0.01163828888888889*9)^2). Linear independent-variance approximation retained as common initialization, not asserted to exactly reconstruct either structure's posttruncation variance.

bmi_reference.derivation: Lognormal mean26.5 by construction; transferred to Pani as a fixed assumption.

glucose_reference.derivation: Analytic mean of Normal(91.8,9^2) truncated(0,126), using standard normal density/CDF; fixed same in both contexts.
